title: Eventual smallness of an exponential tail
statement:
For every real $p > 0$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists a natural number $N$ such that for all natural numbers $m \ge N$ one has
\[
\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{mp}{3}\right) < \varepsilon.
\]
hypotheses_covered: conclusion holds for all natural m ≥ N
replaced:
For any $p > 0$ and any $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists $N$ such that for all $m \ge N$ one has
$e^{-mp/3} < \varepsilon$; that is, the tail term decays to $0$.
